description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for Git's diff and diff-tree commands, focusing on pathspec restrictions and wildcards.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the given commands.

methods.name: compare_diff_raw
methods.description: Compares the raw output of diff commands against expected output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output is empty.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Sets up a test environment, such as initializing repositories.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test suite.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in the repository with the given message.
